verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes is an infrastructure platform for running untrusted/agent code in isolated containers, not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools via MCP. There is no evidence of it acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers to gain tool capabilities — the community mention of 'MCP-JS' is about a separate JS agent runtime project, not Modal itself consuming MCP servers. This axis is a category mismatch for an infrastructure/sandbox execution product.
